description: Send a batch's checks that got no answer to the checking service again: `uncertain` ones, and ones on hold after their retries ran out. Each may count again. A canceled batch answers 409 serverErrors.checkRunCancelled: start a new batch instead. Each address a checking service answers, ours or the paid one, counts once against your plan's checks for the month; a retry after the paid service failed counts again. When none are left (a plan with no monthly limit never runs out) it answers 429 serverErrors.quotaAddressChecks, with `details.resetAt` (the 1st, 00:00 UTC) and `details.upgradeTo`. It does so whenever the call would queue a check, even one we would then answer for free, without the checking service. While the workspace's last payment has failed, the same call answers 402 serverErrors.checksPaymentFailed and queues nothing, until the workspace owner updates the card (get_billing; a manage_billing handoff asks them). At most 30 of these calls a minute per workspace.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: retry_email_check_run
title: Retry a batch's unanswered checks
